title: Over 30,000 nuraghe towers on Sardinia

tellings.quote: And there were over 30,000 of these things on the island of Sardinia.

plain: The Italian island of Sardinia once held "over 30,000" nuraghe, ancient round stone towers, according to a researcher named Tim Alberino. He mentions the number to Michels in an episode about giants, without naming a source. He brings it up to show how much building an old, little-understood people did on a single island.
